snippet.title: Zaos — Official Teaser | The Next-Generation MMORPG | Closed Beta 13.11.2026
snippet.description:
Official teaser for Zaos, the next-generation fantasy MMORPG.

Zaos keeps the heart of classic fantasy MMORPGs: the hunt, the stones, the refine, the four classes. Everything around it was rebuilt to stand next to today's MMORPGs.

Closed Beta: 13 November 2026, 18:00 UTC. Limited seats.
Sign up: https :// zaos.global / register
Full presentation: https :// zaos.global / presentation
Discord: https:// zaos.global / discord

• One shared world, 8 class paths, 9 dungeons
• Flying mounts
• PvM and PvP
• 16 languages
• Free to play, no pay-to-win
• Windows, macOS and Linux; Android and iOS coming soon

#Zaos #MMORPG #FantasyMMORPG #Teaser #ClosedBeta
